hypotheses.name: BTCUSD H1 Donchian 20-bar breakout, volume filter, ATR trailing exit
hypotheses.notes: Entry: close > Donchian(20) high with volume > 1.5x SMA(vol,20). Exit: chandelier/ATR trailing (2.5x ATR). R:R target >= 1:2. Cost ceiling: avg win >= 3% so 24.75 bps RT + slippage stays < 5% of win.

hypotheses.name: EURUSD M15 London-session breakout of Asian range, volatility-expansion filter
hypotheses.notes: Entry: breakout of Asian range (00:00-06:00 UTC) at London open (07:00 UTC) with ATR(5)/ATR(20) > 1.25. Exit: fixed R:R >= 1:1.5 or NY-session time exit. Filters spread widening during news.
